locations.name: BARRACÓ
locations.description: A cool-looking open-air cocktail bar tucked into Deià — thatched shade sails, bamboo screening and woven-rope stools around a warm-lit bar, with a relaxed sunset-terrace vibe. Steps from the La Residencia / Hotel Es Molí base, it is an easy pre- or post-dinner cocktail stop on a Deià evening. Found on Google Maps; unvetted by reviews yet, but exactly the scenic, romantic cocktail spot the trip is built around.
locations.address: Carrer Viña Vieja, 6, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Found while browsing Google Maps — a cool-looking open-air cocktail bar in Deià with thatched shade, bamboo and woven-rope stools.
